_about: Per-repository package pins applied on top of the declared dependencies. Every entry needs evidence and a status. These deviate from the public setup.py, which installs the highest wheel of each name.

isort.evidence: mined isort tasks: gold fails at start-up with 'No module named pkg_resources' (isort's example plugins load through pkg_resources, which setuptools 81 and later no longer ships).
isort.status: mined tasks only; not part of the competition dataset

rich.evidence: rich_4070 gold: with pygments 2.21.0, 6 of 32 tests in test_syntax.py fail (ANSI colour output differs); with 2.20.0 all 32 pass. The dataset wheelhouse ships both 2.20.0 and 2.21.0. Seven rich tasks fail under 2.21.0.
rich.status: inferred, not confirmed: the task authors presumably validated gold in the real scorer, so it likely uses 2.20.0 for rich. Ask the organizers.
